notes.title: 💥 Update 1.2 – MONSTERS HAVE INVADED FANTASY BALL! 🤪⚽
notes.notes:
[h1]🚨 INVASION ALERT 🚨[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33195363/dc0536f53bba57ffd0eedc29a611936a99b9acd3.png[/img]

[h2]A horde of orcs has invaded Fantasy Ball! These new bots are ready to train with you… or just smash everything in sight.[/h2]

[h3]➡️ Their technique? Smashing the ball like barbarians.
➡️ Their strategy? None.
➡️ Their reaction to the new magic ball? “OOOH, SHINY!” 🤩[/h3]

Yes, goodbye to the old leather ball! It’s time for a sparkling magic ball ✨. More beautiful, more powerful… and even more unpredictable!

So, ready to dive into this enchanted chaos? Good luck… and watch out for the over-excited monsters! 💀⚡

notes.title: Credits and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]CREDITS[/b]
It's always important to credit people who worked on a game.
This is now done !
On the "Match Settings" panel, you now have a new "Credits" button, allowing you to see who is the formidable small team behind Fantasy Ball.


[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
We've identified some bugs that we have fixed.

notes.title: Warrior, Controller and Performances Update
notes.notes:
Greeting Champions !

We have updated the way the Warrior plays !
It now uses its weapon to strike the ball or any other participants in its range!

We've also increased the number of controller supported, and made possible to play with the keyboard!

Have fun!
